notes:
What's new in 0.1.62:
• Cinema Library is now the default look for new setups (existing users unaffected)
• Faster conversions on older PCs: your graphics card now helps read video, not just encode it
• Fixed HDR conversion failing on PCs with more than one graphics processor
• Conversions now properly pause when you pause playback, instead of running in the background
• New optional H.265 (HEVC) output for compatible devices, off by default
• New setting: choose where converted files are stored, with a size limit
• Fixed AV1 conversions silently starting as H.264
• Advanced: point Beebo at your own ffmpeg for the x264 encoder (Settings > Playback)
• One shared sign-in for the owner and household members connecting away from home
• Offensive names are now blocked everywhere; new personal web addresses need 5+ characters
